general.name: Death Sense
general.desc: Allows you to sense the corpses of other Gyldhunters.

general.name: Gyldenmist Tolerance
general.desc: Increases resistance to the Gyldenmist, slowing the rate of Gyldening.

general.name: Monster Hunter
general.desc: Increases damage dealt to monsters but reduces damage dealt to Gyldhunters.

general.name: Regular
general.desc: Woodling merchants will offer you a discount during matches.

general.name: Swift Exit
general.desc: Allows you to learn the spawn location of the Smuggler Woodling and Soul Ferry in advance.

general.name: Woodling Bane
general.desc: Greatly increases damage dealt to Returner Woodlings.

Mercenary.name: Absolute Punishment
Mercenary.desc: The last hit of Shield Dash reduces the skill's remaining cooldown when hitting an enemy player.

Mercenary.name: Blade Charge
Mercenary.desc: While in the Blade Edge or Strong Edge state, Sword and Shield attacks deal increased damage.

Mercenary.name: Block Damage Boost
Mercenary.desc: All Perfect Blocks grant you a shield and briefly increase damage dealt and your Movement Speed.

Mercenary.name: Bounce
Mercenary.desc: Shield Slam can be quickly cast while blocking with the shield raised.

Mercenary.name: Combo Energy Recovery
Mercenary.desc: Landing consecutive Hammer attacks recovers Energy.

Mercenary.name: Dash
Mercenary.desc: Increases the dash distance of Hammer Dash.

Mercenary.name: Dynamic Charge
Mercenary.desc: You can move and dodge while charging Skullcrusher. You may dodge up to 2 times, and each dodge consumes Energy. Once you dodge during charging, the skill's cooldown will be the same as that of a Lv.2 charge cast.

Mercenary.name: Endless Whirlwind
Mercenary.desc: Increase the rotation speed, Movement Speed, and turning speed of Hammer Spin.

Mercenary.name: Fearless
Mercenary.desc: The Whirling Cut (Dash) skill becomes available on Sword and Shield. Whirling Cut (Dash): Quickly dash to attack, dealing Physical Damage. Use this skill again within a short time to cast Whirling Cut. Whirling Cut (Dash) has a shorter base cooldown in trio mode.

Mercenary.name: Feral Attack
Mercenary.desc: Stonebreaker Slash can be cast during the Breakaway window, but when cast this way, it cannot be held down.

Mercenary.name: Foresight
Mercenary.desc: The Whirling Cut (Bounce) skill becomes available on Sword and Shield. Whirling Cut (Block): Raise the shield for an omnidirectional Perfect Block, then perform a fierce slash dealing Physical Damage. Use this skill again to cast Whirling Cut. Whirling Cut (Block) has a shorter base cooldown in trio mode.

Mercenary.name: Hammer of Convergence
Mercenary.desc: After a charge-type skill grants Super Armor through charging, it greatly increases Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance. This effect is removed when Super Armor ends.

Mercenary.name: Indomitable Will
Mercenary.desc: Stack the Indomitable Will effect when attacked. There is a brief interval between effect triggers.

Mercenary.name: Iron-Clad Body
Mercenary.desc: Skullcrusher on Lv.1 Charge grants Super Armor during casting.

Mercenary.name: Leap Step
Mercenary.desc: You can move, jump, and dodge while charging Earthshaker. You may dodge up to 2 times, and each dodge consumes Energy. Once you dodge during charging, the skill's cooldown will be the same as that of a Lv.2 charge cast.

Mercenary.name: Opportunist
Mercenary.desc: Increase Movement Speed during Block.

Mercenary.name: Perfect Defense
Mercenary.desc: After Block, there is a very brief window to trigger Perfect Block, but using Block consumes Energy. After a successful Perfect Block, you can immediately enter the Momentum status. Additionally, a special Block skill can be cast during the Breakaway window. This skill can only be used to trigger Perfect Block and cannot maintain the shield for long.

Mercenary.name: Powerful Rock Sling
Mercenary.desc: Warhammer Sling can be held to perform a Lv.1 charge. Lv.1 Charge: Increases maximum range and Damage Multiplier.

Mercenary.name: Raging Earth Shake
Mercenary.desc: Increases the slow effect of Shield Slam, and enemies directly hit by the shield are Stunned for a period.

Mercenary.name: Relentless Advance
Mercenary.desc: You can move and dodge while charging Power Hammer and Punishing Hammer. You may dodge up to 2 times, and each dodge consumes Energy.

Mercenary.name: Resilient Body
Mercenary.desc: After a charge-type skill reaches the next phase, you gain 2 stacks of Indomitable Will. For hold-to-use skills, you gain 1 stack of Indomitable Will periodically.

Mercenary.name: Rising to the Challenge
Mercenary.desc: After successfully blocking during Shield Dash, enemies on hit by this skill are Stunned for a period of time.

Mercenary.name: Rock Scatter
Mercenary.desc: Warhammer Sling throws 3 stones; however, the damage, damage area, and impact of the stones are reduced.

Mercenary.name: Shield Break
Mercenary.desc: Hammer basic attacks deal increased damage and additional damage to shields.

Mercenary.name: Shield Buildup
Mercenary.desc: Sword Tip stacks gained from basic attacks and Impalement are replaced by Shield Pressure. Upon reaching 6 stacks of Shield Pressure, you gain 1 stack of Momentum. Momentum can accumulate up to 2 stacks. Shield attacks from skills also grant 2 stacks of Shield Pressure on hit. When you have Momentum, you can press [Major_Action] and [Minor_Action] to consume 1 stack of Momentum and unleash Shockwave Strike.

Mercenary.name: Shield Strike Taunt
Mercenary.desc: Hitting enemies with a shield attack briefly taunts them. This effect has a cooldown.

Mercenary.name: Skullcrushing Echo
Mercenary.desc: When a charged attack or skill hits, it reduces the cooldown of Skullcrusher.

Mercenary.name: Stacking Blade
Mercenary.desc: The number of Sword Tip stacks required to enter the Blade Edge and Strong Edge states is reduced to 4.

Mercenary.name: Steel Sanctuary
Mercenary.desc: Extends the duration of Hammer Spin's Super Armor effect.

Mercenary.name: Steel Skull
Mercenary.desc: Increase Critical Damage Resistance.

Mercenary.name: Stonebreaker Counter
Mercenary.desc: After Stonebreaker Slash's Perfect Block succeeds, it grants Super Armor during the skill and increases the skill's damage.

Mercenary.name: Stonebreaker Edge
Mercenary.desc: Gain 1 stack of Sword Tip on skill hit. While in the Blade Edge or Strong Edge state, this skill deals increased damage.

Mercenary.name: Sturdy Shield
Mercenary.desc: Successful Block adds 1 stack of Indomitable Will. Successful Perfect Block adds 3 stacks of Indomitable Will.

Mercenary.name: Sudden Edge
Mercenary.desc: Increases the travel distance of Stonebreaker Slash when holding the skill.

Mercenary.name: Super Armor Armament
Mercenary.desc: Gain Super Armor while casting Hammer Dash.

Mercenary.name: Sword Edge
Mercenary.desc: Sword attacks from skills also grant 1 stack of Sword Tip on hit.

Mercenary.name: Thunderous Hammer
Mercenary.desc: When a charged attack hits, it reduces the cooldown of Earthshaker.

Mercenary.name: Titan Hammer Strike
Mercenary.desc: When the Hammer deals damage, or when you perform Breakaway, it accumulates Stun stacks. At 6 Stun stacks, the Hammer's next attack will Stun the target and remove all stacks. [Major_Action] hits grant 1 Stun stack, while [Minor_Action] and skill hits grant 2 Stun stacks. Breakaway grants 1 Stun stack. Note: Hammer Spin hits during the spin only grant 1 Stun stack. The hit from the final strike grants 2 Stun stacks.

Mercenary.name: Unstoppable
Mercenary.desc: When triggering Super Armor Clash, your own Energy will not be reduced, and the enemy will be Stunned.

Mercenary.name: Whirling Edge
Mercenary.desc: Gain 1 stack of Sword Tip on skill hit. While in the Blade Edge or Strong Edge state, this skill deals increased damage.

Mercenary.name: Whirling Technique
Mercenary.desc: After a successful Perfect Block triggered by Whirling Cut (Block), Whirling Cut grants Super Armor, and its Damage Multiplier is increased.

Mercenary.name: Will to Survive
Mercenary.desc: Each enemy hit by Shield Slam adds 3 stacks of Indomitable Will.

Sorcerer.name: All-Seeing Insight
Sorcerer.desc: Increases the maximum uses of Eye of Insight.

Sorcerer.name: Arcane Charge
Sorcerer.desc: Reduces the base cooldown of Crystal Icebolt and increases its maximum duration.

Sorcerer.name: Breakaway Burst
Sorcerer.desc: Star Shock can be cast during the Breakaway window.

Sorcerer.name: Chant Guard
Sorcerer.desc: Increases Chanting Speed for Stardust Magic spells. When chanting, the first minor impact received will not interrupt chanting (Stardust Torrent's casting phase also benefits from this effect). This effect has a cooldown and cannot be active at the same time as Eloquence within a short period.

Sorcerer.name: Deep Frost Embrace
Sorcerer.desc: Reduces the base Energy cost of Deep Freeze.

Sorcerer.name: Divine Speed
Sorcerer.desc: Increase Movement Speed while Shadow Veil is active.

Sorcerer.name: Elemental Arcana
Sorcerer.desc: Elemental reactions are enhanced to trigger additional effects based on the element type that detonates the Elemental Mark. Thunder: Fires a lightning chain at the nearest enemy, bouncing multiple times and dealing Magic Damage to enemies. It can chain off allies; when doing so, it restores Energy to them. When the lightning chain strikes the same unit multiple times, the Damage Multiplier diminishes. Fire: Continuously deals Magic Damage to enemies for a period of time. Ice: Inflicts Frozen on enemies for a period of time. Fire Bolt and Thunderstrike do not apply Elemental Marks to enemies when chanting is incomplete.

Sorcerer.name: Elemental Surge
Sorcerer.desc: After triggering Elemental Arcana, gain Surge for a period of time. While Surge is active, casting elemental spells consumes Surge. If a spell that consumes Surge hits an enemy, it immediately triggers Elemental Arcana. This effect has a cooldown.

Sorcerer.name: Enhanced Shield
Sorcerer.desc: Increases the duration of Arcane Armor.

Sorcerer.name: Enhanced Ward
Sorcerer.desc: Reduces the base cooldown of Cryptic Ward.

Sorcerer.name: Ethereal
Sorcerer.desc: Jumping does not interrupt chanting.

Sorcerer.name: Exhilarated Stride
Sorcerer.desc: Increases the Chanting Speed for Phantom Step while increasing its cooldown.

Sorcerer.name: Flexible Casting
Sorcerer.desc: Increases Movement Speed while chanting.

Sorcerer.name: Furious Thunder
Sorcerer.desc: Reduces the Movement Speed of enemies hit by Thunderstrike. This effect can stack up to 2 times.

Sorcerer.name: Hurricane
Sorcerer.desc: Increases the knockback distance of Cryptic Cyclone.

Sorcerer.name: Lightning Breath
Sorcerer.desc: Each enemy hit by Thunderstorm Sigil reduces its remaining cooldown.

Sorcerer.name: Masterful Technique
Sorcerer.desc: Increase Movement Speed after casting an Elemental Magic.

Sorcerer.name: Memorization
Sorcerer.desc: Increases the Chanting Speed of Gravitational Vortex.

Sorcerer.name: No Escape
Sorcerer.desc: Increases the damage area of Meteor Charm. Meteor Charm does not benefit from this effect when chanting is incomplete.

Sorcerer.name: Quagmire
Sorcerer.desc: During Rockblast preparation, reduces the Movement Speed of all enemies within range.

Sorcerer.name: Rapid Flamestrike
Sorcerer.desc: Fire Bolt deals partial True Damage. Fire Bolt does not benefit from this effect when chanting is incomplete.

Sorcerer.name: Shattered Bolt
Sorcerer.desc: Thunder Pierce no longer generates an electric field, but can be cast once more upon hit, shattering the lightning javelin into smaller bolts that attack nearby enemies, dealing damage and applying 1 stack of Elemental Mark to targets hit.

Sorcerer.name: Speed Seal Touch
Sorcerer.desc: Star Shock knocks back enemies and reduces their Movement Speed and Dodge Distance for a period of time.

Sorcerer.name: Stardust Arcana
Sorcerer.desc: Press [Fn] to activate Stardust Ultimate. Upon successful casting of Stardust Ultimate, your next spell skips the channeling phase. This effect has a cooldown.

Sorcerer.name: Stardust Reversal
Sorcerer.desc: While Stardust Arcana is on cooldown, each skill cast reduces its remaining cooldown by a certain amount.

Sorcerer.name: Storm Impact
Sorcerer.desc: Reduces the Dodge Distance and Movement Speed of enemies hit by Stardust Tempest.

Sorcerer.name: Summon Flameblade
Sorcerer.desc: Flameblade deals a portion of damage as True DMG.

Sorcerer.name: Survival Instinct
Sorcerer.desc: When Energy is low, increases Energy Recovery Speed.

Sorcerer.name: Swift Strike
Sorcerer.desc: Meteor Impact can now knock up enemy players in Super Armor state.

Sorcerer.name: Tempest Hunt
Sorcerer.desc: Stardust Tempest will track nearby enemies.

Sorcerer.name: Thunder Roar
Sorcerer.desc: Hitting an enemy with Thunder Pierce refreshes the skill's Cooldown.

Sorcerer.name: Unending Torrent
Sorcerer.desc: Stardust Torrent can be guided into a stronger stage.

Sorcerer.name: Unobstructed Passage
Sorcerer.desc: Forbidden Gate no longer blocks allied units. Allied units passing through Forbidden Gate gain increased Movement Speed for a period of time.

Sorcerer.name: Vitality Chant
Sorcerer.desc: Dodging does not interrupt chanting. This effect has a cooldown.

Sorcerer.name: Vitality Heal
Sorcerer.desc: Restore Energy while Mistwalk is active.

Blackarrow.name: Accumulation
Blackarrow.desc: While not in the Divine Power state, each use of Throw accelerates the charging rate of Divine Infusion.

Blackarrow.name: Astound
Blackarrow.desc: Increases the knockback distance of fully drawn Concussive Arrows.

Blackarrow.name: Battle-fed
Blackarrow.desc: When carrying at least 2 Hunter's Arrows, hitting an enemy with a shot reduces the remaining cooldown of all skills.

Blackarrow.name: Blood Infection
Blackarrow.desc: Upon hitting an enemy, Bloodfly Arrow deals reduced DoT but inflicts bonus Swarm stacks. Hitting an enemy that has Swarm stacks with any fully drawn arrow other than Bloodfly Arrow will detonate the Swarm, dealing bonus damage. The more Swarm stacks the target has, the higher the damage dealt. The swarm detonation deals Critical Damage, with a portion converted to True Damage.

Blackarrow.name: Cold Infusion
Blackarrow.desc: Frostblight Bomb reduces the Movement Speed of enemies entering the blast area during the delayed explosion phase for a period of time.

Blackarrow.name: Colossal Power
Blackarrow.desc: Increase Charging Speed for shooting.

Blackarrow.name: Crippling Pain
Blackarrow.desc: Enemies damaged by Impact Grenade have reduced Movement Speed for a period of time.

Blackarrow.name: Dedicated Focus
Blackarrow.desc: While in the Divine Power state, switching special javelins no longer plays a weapon-swap animation. Additionally, the duration timer for the Divine Power state pauses while using Breaker Stance or skills.

Blackarrow.name: Detonation
Blackarrow.desc: Dealing damage to an enemy directly hit by Lightning Rod Javelin instantly triggers a lightning strike, but reduces the remaining duration of Lightning Rod Javelin on that target.

Blackarrow.name: Divine Pierce
Blackarrow.desc: Using Divine Infusion instantly grants max stacks of Swift Shadow. Additionally, while in the Divine Power state, Charged Throws no longer consume Swift Shadow.

Blackarrow.name: Dodge Power Shot
Blackarrow.desc: Changes roll into dodge and unlocks Dodge Power Shot. Dodge Power Shot: Shoot immediately after dodging, consuming additional Energy to quickly fire the currently loaded quick-charge arrow toward enemies near the crosshairs. Quick-charge arrows can activate all special effects of fully drawn arrows but have a lower Damage Multiplier. This skill has a cooldown.

Blackarrow.name: Dodge Rapid Shot
Blackarrow.desc: Changes roll into dodge and unlocks Dodge Rapid Shot. Dodge Rapid Shot: Shoot immediately after dodging, consuming additional Energy to quickly fire both the currently loaded arrow and a normal arrow toward enemies near the crosshairs. This skill has a cooldown.

Blackarrow.name: Fleetfoot
Blackarrow.desc: Gain a temporary Speed Boost after using Trickstep Javelin.

Blackarrow.name: Focus Fire
Blackarrow.desc: Rapid Arrows increase the Damage Multiplier with each hit on the same enemy.

Blackarrow.name: Frostbind
Blackarrow.desc: A fully charged throw of Frost Javelin has a larger explosion radius. Direct hits on enemies will Immobilize them for a period of time.

Blackarrow.name: Frostburst
Blackarrow.desc: If an enemy is hit by Frost Javelin while a previous explosion has not yet triggered, hitting them again with Frost Javelin detonates it instantly, dealing Physical Damage to all enemies within range and Freezing them for a period of time.

Blackarrow.name: Full Draw
Blackarrow.desc: Increases the Damage Multiplier of fully drawn arrows.

Blackarrow.name: Heightened Senses
Blackarrow.desc: Increases the number of uses for Predator's Senses and reduces its base cooldown.

Blackarrow.name: Impact
Blackarrow.desc: Increases the Impact of Shockwave Javelin.

Blackarrow.name: Laceration
Blackarrow.desc: Enemies hit by Barbed Arrow are Stunned for a period of time if they reach the maximum number of dodge uses before the Barbed Arrow effect ends.

Blackarrow.name: Lasting Pain
Blackarrow.desc: After hitting an enemy with a shot, increases the duration of all active debuffs on that enemy, with non-crowd-control debuffs receiving a greater duration increase.

Blackarrow.name: Latent Potential
Blackarrow.desc: Activating Divine Infusion recovers a certain amount of Energy.

Blackarrow.name: Leapback
Blackarrow.desc: Increases the Knockback and backward leap distance of Javelin Sweep.

Blackarrow.name: Lightning Spread
Blackarrow.desc: Increases the chaining range of the lightning generated by a fully drawn Lightning Arrow.

Blackarrow.name: Linebreaker
Blackarrow.desc: Javelins thrown by consuming max stacks of Swift Shadow fly faster and deal a higher Damage Multiplier.

Blackarrow.name: Lingering
Blackarrow.desc: Increases the poison duration and total Damage Multiplier of Spore Arrow, but reduces the Damage Multiplier per second.

Blackarrow.name: Long Shot
Blackarrow.desc: Fully drawn Steel Arrows gain increased Impact and Damage Multiplier when hitting a second target after piercing a unit.

Blackarrow.name: Marksman
Blackarrow.desc: Fully-drawn arrows will home in on enemies near the crosshairs.

Blackarrow.name: Measured Pace
Blackarrow.desc: When carrying at least 2 Archer's Arrows, fully drawing and immediately firing Normal Arrows recovers Energy.

Blackarrow.name: Neurotoxin
Blackarrow.desc: After Paralysis Arrow expires, it leaves an aftereffect that reduces the enemy's Skill Cooldown Speed for a period of time.

Blackarrow.name: Pinnacle
Blackarrow.desc: Divine Infusion can be charged 2 times.

Blackarrow.name: Power Infusion
Blackarrow.desc: Increases the effective range of Featherlight Arrows.

Blackarrow.name: Powerful Scattershot
Blackarrow.desc: After Scattershot knocks back enemies, if they stop due to obstruction, they will be Stunned. The greater the impact force when enemies hit obstacles, the longer the Stun duration.

Blackarrow.name: Pursuer
Blackarrow.desc: After hitting an enemy with a shot, increase Movement Speed for a period of time.

Blackarrow.name: Pursuit
Blackarrow.desc: Among enemies hit by Stitch and Thread, the one with the lowest Health is Exposed for a period of time and takes increased damage from javelins during this time.

Blackarrow.name: Pursuit Mark
Blackarrow.desc: Enemies hit by normal arrows have reduced Movement Speed for a period of time. This effect can stack up to 3 times.

Blackarrow.name: Rapid Barrage
Blackarrow.desc: Increases the Damage Multiplier of quick shots.

Blackarrow.name: Sepsis
Blackarrow.desc: Increases the Damage Multiplier of fully charged Splatter Arrow's splash.

Blackarrow.name: Shadow Hoard
Blackarrow.desc: Throwing a javelin after completing any charge stage, using a skill, or performing a roll grants 1 stack of Swift Shadow, up to 3 stacks. When Swift Shadow reaches max stacks, your charging speed increases. Executing a Charged Throw at max stacks will consume all Swift Shadow stacks.

Blackarrow.name: Shockwave
Blackarrow.desc: After Sonic Arrow hits terrain, it emits sound waves multiple times over a period of time. This effect will not trigger if it hits players or monsters.

Blackarrow.name: Steady Stealth
Blackarrow.desc: Attacks received during Shadow Step's Stealth no longer remove Stealth.

Blackarrow.name: Tactical Adjustments
Blackarrow.desc: Increases Movement Speed when shooting.

Blackarrow.name: Thunderclap
Blackarrow.desc: When Lightning Rod Javelin is thrown at max charge, all subsequent lightning strikes generated will deal Impact.

Blackarrow.name: Undying Breath
Blackarrow.desc: While in the Divine Power state, throwing a Barbed Javelin does not reduce the duration of the Divine Power state.

Blackarrow.name: Unerring Aim
Blackarrow.desc: You can no longer charge your attacks while in the Divine Power state, but thrown javelins will track enemies near the crosshair.

Blackarrow.name: Unstoppable Edge
Blackarrow.desc: Sky Piercer's Physical Damage is partially converted to True Damage.

Blackarrow.name: Windchaser
Blackarrow.desc: Gain a Speed Boost when throwing a Swift Javelin.

Shadowstrix.name: Aftereffect
Shadowstrix.desc: Upon casting Spinning Slash, increase Physical Damage for a period of time.

Shadowstrix.name: All or Nothing
Shadowstrix.desc: Shadow Wheel Slash consumes more Energy but deals increased Physical Damage.

Shadowstrix.name: Ambush
Shadowstrix.desc: While in Stealth, you cannot be detected and will not make any sound if not moving.

Shadowstrix.name: Ambush Momentum
Shadowstrix.desc: Casting Shadow Strike increases Physical Damage for a period of time.

Shadowstrix.name: Ankle Cut
Shadowstrix.desc: After Shadow Wheel Slash hits an enemy, reduce their Movement Speed for a period of time.

Shadowstrix.name: Ascetic Technique
Shadowstrix.desc: Hitting enemies with Fang Rush or Bloody Blade Dance additionally recovers Energy.

Shadowstrix.name: Battle Frenzy
Shadowstrix.desc: After hitting an enemy with Dual Blades, increases Physical Damage dealt by Dual Blades for a period of time, stacking up to 5 times. At maximum stacks, additionally grants Physical Piercing.

Shadowstrix.name: Blackout
Shadowstrix.desc: Enemies hit multiple times by Crow Storm are stunned. Players already stunned only take damage and do not accumulate Crow Storm stacks.

Shadowstrix.name: Bloodthirst
Shadowstrix.desc: Killing an enemy player immediately resets the remaining cooldown of Sneak and fully recovers Energy.

Shadowstrix.name: Bloodthirst Frenzy
Shadowstrix.desc: After hitting an enemy with Bloody Blade Dance, increases Physical Damage for a period of time, stacking up to 4 times. During Bloody Blade Dance, you can deflect enemy projectiles. Successfully deflecting enemy projectiles recovers a certain amount of Energy.

Shadowstrix.name: Breath Control
Shadowstrix.desc: Inspiring Impale no longer consumes Energy.

Shadowstrix.name: Charge-Up
Shadowstrix.desc: Flash Stride can be held to perform a Lv.2 charge. Lv.1 Charge: Slightly increases Damage Multiplier and dash distance. Lv.2 Charge: Increases Damage Multiplier and dash distance.

Shadowstrix.name: Combat Euphoria
Shadowstrix.desc: After hitting an enemy, increase Movement Speed for a period of time.

Shadowstrix.name: Deep Charge
Shadowstrix.desc: Flurry Strike can now be charged to Lv.2. Lv.2 Charge: Increases Damage Multiplier and dash distance. Lv.1 Charge attacks recover Energy on hit, while Lv.2 Charge attacks recover more Energy on hit.

Shadowstrix.name: Depletion
Shadowstrix.desc: After Poison Crow Mark hits, it applies Healing Block for a period of time.

Shadowstrix.name: Displacement Aftershock
Shadowstrix.desc: Casting Phantom Shift quickly unleashes two sword auras at the teleportation location.

Shadowstrix.name: Element of Surprise
Shadowstrix.desc: After exiting Stealth or Shadow Veil, all Dagger backstabs are treated as critical hits for a period of time. For the duration of Frequency Shift, a successful backstab grants 1 additional Shadow Veil charge, up to 1 extra charge per Stealth activation.

Shadowstrix.name: Enhanced Crow Swarm
Shadowstrix.desc: Increases the flying speed and maximum range of the crows in Crow Storm. Increases the AoE of Crow Storm.

Shadowstrix.name: Evasive Flow
Shadowstrix.desc: Hitting an enemy with Spinning Slash causes your next Dodge within a duration to no longer consume Dodge Energy.

Shadowstrix.name: Excitement
Shadowstrix.desc: When Flash Stride hits, you recover Energy for each enemy hit.

Shadowstrix.name: Forbidden Miasma
Shadowstrix.desc: Within the Smoke Bomb's area of effect, all interactions are disabled for both allies and enemies, and your Smoke Bombs can now be thrown to a targeted area.

Shadowstrix.name: Free Movement
Shadowstrix.desc: After casting Phantom Shift, casting it again will return to the location of the first Phantom Shift cast.

Shadowstrix.name: Frequency Shift
Shadowstrix.desc: Exiting Stealth allows entering Shadow Veil after a brief delay. After exiting Shadow Veil, using a Dagger to attack enemies within a short time will cause you to re-enter Shadow Veil for a fixed duration after a short delay. The maximum number of times you can re-enter Shadow Veil through Frequency Shift after exiting Shadow Veil is 2. This count resets each time you exit Stealth. While in Shadow Veil, pressing [Major_Action] will move you a short distance and deal damage to enemies hit.

Shadowstrix.name: Haste
Shadowstrix.desc: Each time you enter Stealth or Shadow Veil, your Movement Speed is greatly increased for a short duration.

Shadowstrix.name: Heavy Strike Mastery
Shadowstrix.desc: Pursuit Strike no longer consumes Energy, but this effect has a cooldown.

Shadowstrix.name: Lightweight
Shadowstrix.desc:
When performing Light Strikes, Heavy Strikes, and casting skills with dual blades equipped, one dodge can be performed. This dodge still costs dodge energy but allows for earlier recovery cancellation. This effect has a cooldown and can store up to 2 charges.
Lightweight has a shorter cooldown in Trio mode.
Lightweight has a shorter cooldown in Trio mode. Lightweight has a shorter cooldown in Trio mode. Lightweight has a shorter cooldown in Trio mode. Lightweight has a shorter cooldown in Trio mode. Lightweight has a shorter cooldown in Trio mode.

Shadowstrix.name: Lingering Toxin
Shadowstrix.desc: After a successful block, Edgewalker's dash attack hitting an enemy reduces their Movement Speed and Dodge Distance for a period of time.

Shadowstrix.name: Lurking Blow
Shadowstrix.desc: Exiting Stealth unharmed while wielding a Dagger grants significantly increased Physical Damage and continuous Energy recovery for a certain period.

Shadowstrix.name: Nimble
Shadowstrix.desc: When the afterimages summoned by Shadow Strike hit enemies, Shadow Strike's remaining cooldown is greatly reduced.

Shadowstrix.name: Quickstab
Shadowstrix.desc: Edgewalker unlocks a second-stage branch. Shortly after the dash attack ends, press this skill again to move in a chosen direction, dealing Physical Damage to enemies hit.

Shadowstrix.name: Sensory Poison
Shadowstrix.desc: After Poison Crow Mark hits, impair their vision and hearing for a period.

Shadowstrix.name: Shadow Dance
Shadowstrix.desc: Bloody Blade Dance can be used after a dodge. When triggered this way, Bloody Blade Dance comes with a short dash.

Shadowstrix.name: Shadow Slash
Shadowstrix.desc: Each hit of Shadow Wheel Slash's branch attacks reduces the remaining cooldown of Sneak and additionally recovers Energy.

Shadowstrix.name: Shadow Stride
Shadowstrix.desc: While in Stealth, your Movement Speed is increased when moving toward enemies within a certain range.

Shadowstrix.name: Sleight of Hand
Shadowstrix.desc: While in Stealth, interactions won't break Stealth, but the interaction speed will be slower.

Shadowstrix.name: Sneak Prep
Shadowstrix.desc: Poison Crow Mark recovers a certain amount of Energy upon hitting enemies.

Shadowstrix.name: Stance Recovery
Shadowstrix.desc: When Light Strikes hit enemy players, reduces the remaining cooldown of the currently equipped weapon's exclusive skills. Dagger Exclusive Skills: Flash Stride, Sneak, Shadow Strike Dual Blades Exclusive Skills: Spinning Slash, Inspiring Impale

Shadowstrix.name: Swift Sneak
Shadowstrix.desc: Sneak allows you to quickly enter a Stealth state if you have not taken damage from enemy players for a period of time.

Shadowstrix.name: Tetanus
Shadowstrix.desc: After Inspiring Impale hits, it applies Healing Block for a period of time.

Shadowstrix.name: Wild Slash
Shadowstrix.desc: Sword Aura from Bloody Blade Dance recovers Energy upon hitting enemies.

Shadowstrix.name: Wound Buildup
Shadowstrix.desc: When hitting enemies with Dual Blades attacks, applies a stackable Wound that lasts for a short duration. When Wound reaches 8 stacks, it detonates and deals True Damage to the target while also recovering additional Energy for yourself.

Shadowstrix.name: Wound Infection
Shadowstrix.desc: Within the Smoke Bomb's area of effect, reduces enemy Movement Speed and the Healing they receive.

Seer.name: Battle-fed
Seer.desc: Immediately gain a large amount of Curse Mana upon killing a player; immediately gain a small amount of Curse Mana upon killing a monster.

Seer.name: Binding
Seer.desc: When enemy players are within the range of Thorn Sigil, their dodge distance is reduced.

Seer.name: Bloodlust
Seer.desc: When your Health is below a certain percentage of your Maximum Health, increases the healing of [Rune: Drain].

Seer.name: Cutting Pain
Seer.desc: [Rune: Sweep] deals partial True Damage.

Seer.name: Decelerate
Seer.desc: Enemies knocked back by the Intimidation Rune have reduced Movement Speed for a period of time.

Seer.name: Deep Corruption
Seer.desc: Increases the healing reduction effect caused by [Rune: Corruption] and its duration.

Seer.name: Deep Healing
Seer.desc: Healing Art recovers additional Health based on the target's missing Health.

Seer.name: Divine Power
Seer.desc: Attacks during Zeal grant increased Curse Mana.

Seer.name: Ebb and Flow
Seer.desc: Hold [Major_Action] to chant, consuming more Psionic Energy. After hitting an enemy player, it recovers Health for the ally with the lowest Health. Healing scales with Attack.

Seer.name: Efficiency
Seer.desc: Reduces the duration of the Healing Rune but increases the Health recovery rate.

Seer.name: Elation
Seer.desc: After the Blinding Rune causes an enemy to have obstructed vision, the duration they remain Exposed is extended. Additionally, while the enemy is Exposed, all allies gain a Speed Boost when moving toward them.

Seer.name: Electrocution
Seer.desc: While Paralysis Curse is active, movement speed is no longer reduced, and casting while moving is allowed.

Seer.name: Emergency Aid
Seer.desc: Gain a certain amount of Curse Mana after using Breakaway.

Seer.name: Enhanced Tracking
Seer.desc: After firing two enhanced orbs, the next enhanced orb will have greatly increased flight speed and tracking effect.

Seer.name: Extract
Seer.desc: Paralysis Curse recovers a certain amount of Curse Mana upon hitting enemies.

Seer.name: Ferocity
Seer.desc: Gain Super Armor during Zeal with increased Magic Resistance and Physical Resistance.

Seer.name: Fortified Guard
Seer.desc: Increases the shield value provided by the Shelter Rune.

Seer.name: Fracture
Seer.desc: Increases the duration of the Movement Speed reduction effect caused by [Rune: Ankle Cut].

Seer.name: Inexhaustible
Seer.desc: Continuously gain Curse Mana during Zeal.

Seer.name: Infusion
Seer.desc: Immediately recovers a large amount of Curse Mana upon entering Zeal.

Seer.name: Internal Injury
Seer.desc: Impact Sigil reduces the healing received by enemies hit and reduces their Movement Speed.

Seer.name: Keen Edge
Seer.desc: After using the branch attack Shapebreak from Shapeshift, increases Physical Damage and Magic Damage dealt for a period of time.

Seer.name: Leverage
Seer.desc: Allied units within the Windwalker Rune's area of effect gain increased dodge energy recovery speed.

Seer.name: Mastery
Seer.desc: Impact Sigil recovers a certain amount of Curse Mana upon hitting enemies.

Seer.name: Miraculous Healing
Seer.desc: Increases the healing bonus.

Seer.name: Obsession
Seer.desc: Increases Movement Speed during Zeal. Dealing damage to enemies with a Rune: Enchanted Heavy Strike extends the remaining duration of Zeal.

Seer.name: Opportunist Strike
Seer.desc: Enemies hit by Wind Surge are Stunned for a period of time if hit again by an enhanced orb within a short period. The more Psionic Energy the enhanced orb consumes, the longer the Stunned effect lasts.

Seer.name: Pain Relief
Seer.desc: Gain Magic Resistance and Physical Resistance while within the range of Thorn Sigil.

Seer.name: Potency
Seer.desc: Increases the duration and Movement Speed of Shapeshift.

Seer.name: Potent Sanctuary
Seer.desc: Increases shield strength and additionally increases shield strength based on Magic Damage.

Seer.name: Potent Wounding
Seer.desc: Hold [Major_Action] to chant, consuming more Psionic Energy to fire an enhanced orb with a higher Damage Multiplier.

Seer.name: Powerful Wind
Seer.desc: Increases the knockback distance of Wind Surge.

Seer.name: Propel
Seer.desc: Successfully casting Wind Surge increases your Movement Speed for a period of time.

Seer.name: Purify
Seer.desc: Healing Art removes all debuffs with remaining duration from the target.

Seer.name: Quick Chant
Seer.desc: Reduces the chanting time of Psionic Shield.

Seer.name: Relentless
Seer.desc: Dealing damage with a Mace increases the duration of Zeal. The number of times this effect can trigger per Zeal is capped.

Seer.name: Reshape
Seer.desc: If a Shield applied by a Reverent remains undamaged for a period of time, it automatically recovers Shield value. The recovery speed scales with Attack.

Seer.name: Retention
Seer.desc: Increases the duration of Super Armor provided by Death Ward.

Seer.name: Retribution
Seer.desc: When the shield provided by Psionic Shield is destroyed, replaced, or expires, it refunds charge time for the Psionic Shield skill based on the total damage absorbed during its duration.

Seer.name: Rigidity
Seer.desc: Enemies become Stunned for a period of time after breaking free and leaving the Binding Rune's range.

Seer.name: Rune Vulnerability
Seer.desc: When enemies remain in contact with the Burst Rune for an extended period or enter the rune area multiple times, the attached rune energy increases, causing the explosion to have increased Damage Multiplier.

Seer.name: Self-Preservation
Seer.desc: Gain a shield when performing Breakaway. This effect has a cooldown. Shield value scales with Attack.

Seer.name: Shelter
Seer.desc: Stealth persists for a period after leaving the Stealth Rune's area.

Seer.name: Shelter
Seer.desc: When Death Ward's death prevention effect ends, the target gains a shield. Shield value scales with Attack.

Seer.name: Shield Break
Seer.desc: When attacking enemies with a shield, deals increased damage.

Seer.name: Sustain
Seer.desc: The enhanced orb recovers Psionic Energy after landing a critical hit. The more Psionic Energy the enhanced orb consumes, the more Psionic Energy it recovers. If the critical hit strikes a player, it recovers even more Psionic Energy.

Seer.name: Synergy
Seer.desc: While within the range of your own Punishment Rune, hitting an enemy with your magic orb immediately triggers a follow-up attack from the Punishment Rune. The more Psionic Energy consumed by the magic orb that hits the enemy, the higher the Damage Multiplier of the follow-up attack. Follow-up attacks triggered by enhanced orbs restore Psionic Energy to the Reverent.

Seer.name: Vault
Seer.desc: Increases the dash distance of [Rune: Stun].

Seer.name: Vision Plunder
Seer.desc: Enemy players within a certain range of the Blinding Rune have their vision obstructed even if they are not facing it.

Withered Knight.name: Auto Execution
Withered Knight.desc: Wither applied by a Greatsword now automatically executes itself when its duration ends, and the Wither status can no longer be refreshed. However, the explosion from the automatic execution does not apply Wither to affected enemies.

Withered Knight.name: Bad Karma
Withered Knight.desc: Wither applied by a Greatsword also inflicts a linked debuff. When Execute extends Wither's duration, additional linked debuffs are applied. Up to 3 linked debuffs can be applied, in order: slightly reduced Movement Speed; slightly increased Vulnerability; slight Health loss over time. When Wither is removed, all linked debuffs are removed as well.

Withered Knight.name: Brute Force
Withered Knight.desc: Further enhances Charged Dash, increasing charging speed and movement speed during the charge. Additionally, dealing damage with this skill reduces the enemy's Movement Speed for a short duration.

Withered Knight.name: Buildup
Withered Knight.desc: Every two rounds of rapid thrusts from Spear Barrage increases the charge level of Charged Dash.

Withered Knight.name: Cataclysm
Withered Knight.desc: The sweeping attack from Breakthrough Charge's second-stage branch can immediately execute enemies affected by Wither.

Withered Knight.name: Collective Punishment
Withered Knight.desc: The area explosion from Wither executed by a Greatsword reapplies Wither to all affected enemies.

Withered Knight.name: Counter-Impact
Withered Knight.desc: The shield gains a permanent enhancement, reducing Block Energy Cost. It also enhances Charged Dash, causing its shield bash and spear thrust to deal AoE damage.

Withered Knight.name: Crime
Withered Knight.desc: Execute with a Greatsword no longer consumes Wither (but damage is slightly reduced) and extends the duration of Wither.

Withered Knight.name: Crushing Force
Withered Knight.desc: Rainbow Piercer's final strike has increased knockback distance. Enemies knocked back are stunned briefly if they collide with a wall. If they collide with another enemy, both units are stunned.

Withered Knight.name: Defensive Shift
Withered Knight.desc: During Sacred Bulwark, you can move and slowly turn.

Withered Knight.name: Dominance
Withered Knight.desc: The sweeping attack from Breakthrough Charge's second-stage branch grants brief Super Armor.

Withered Knight.name: Endless Flow
Withered Knight.desc: Increases Skill Cooldown Speed.

Withered Knight.name: Fight to the Death
Withered Knight.desc: Rainbow Piercer can continuously push a small-sized unit (player or mob) forward. The pushed unit cannot use Breakaway, though the Energy cost of the skill increases while pushing. Units in a special state (such as Super Armor or Frozen) cannot be pushed.

Withered Knight.name: Fluid Maneuver
Withered Knight.desc: Intervene's shield covers a larger area and grants an additional boost to the ally's Movement Speed.

Withered Knight.name: Focus
Withered Knight.desc: Compresses the attack width of Breaker Shield Bash while greatly increasing its range, additionally applying an effect that reduces the enemy's dodge distance.

Withered Knight.name: Grappling Hook
Withered Knight.desc: Thorn Guide can interact with the environment (e.g., ground, walls) to pull yourself toward them for rapid movement.

Withered Knight.name: Greatsword Specialization
Withered Knight.desc: When wielding a Greatsword, you can equip one additional skill, and gain a shield for a period of time after a successful execution against an enemy player. This effect has a cooldown, and the shield value is higher in trio mode. However, the Polearm and Shield has one skill slot disabled.

Withered Knight.name: Impalement
Withered Knight.desc: Withering Mark can pass through enemies to hit more targets, and its knockback effect is enhanced.

Withered Knight.name: Instant Wither
Withered Knight.desc: Withering Mark can immediately execute enemies affected by Wither. (If the target is not inflicted with Wither, Wither will be applied first.)

Withered Knight.name: Irresistible Force
Withered Knight.desc: Dealing damage with Spear Barrage increases the damage of all thrusting attacks for a period of time. This effect can stack up to 3 times.

Withered Knight.name: Javelin: Heavy Kick
Withered Knight.desc: The sweeping strike of Javelin Thrust is replaced with a heavy kick that knocks the enemy back a significant distance (allowing for camera adjustments during the animation to control the knockback direction). This effect only applies to small-sized units and players, and cannot affect units in a special state, such as Super Armor or Frozen.

Withered Knight.name: Javelin: Stun
Withered Knight.desc: Enemies knocked back by the heavy kick are stunned briefly if they collide with a wall. If they collide with another enemy, both units are stunned.

Withered Knight.name: Joint Pierce
Withered Knight.desc: Enemies hit by Thorn Guide have reduced Movement Speed and dodge distance for a period of time.

Withered Knight.name: Lasting Judgment
Withered Knight.desc: Greatly increases the duration for which the weapon remains fully charged with Judgment energy.

Withered Knight.name: Legacy
Withered Knight.desc: When enemies affected by Wither die, you recover a small amount of Health. The recovery amount increases based on the number of debuffs linked to the target's Wither state, and is further increased if the target is a player. This effect does not apply when equipped with a Polearm and Shield.

Withered Knight.name: Long Range
Withered Knight.desc: Radiant Retribution's displacement distance is increased.

Withered Knight.name: Momentum
Withered Knight.desc: After Breakaway, the weapon is instantly fully charged with Judgment energy.

Withered Knight.name: Momentum Shift
Withered Knight.desc: Allows up to 2 dodges while raising the shield during Charged Dash (consumes Dodge Energy). Each dodge executed during this time increases the charge level of Charged Dash by 1.

Withered Knight.name: Off-Balance
Withered Knight.desc: Attacks from Breaker Shield Bash apply a Slow effect.

Withered Knight.name: Polearm and Shield Specialization
Withered Knight.desc: When wielding a Polearm and Shield, you can equip one additional skill, and deal increased Physical Damage for a period of time after a successful execution. However, the Greatsword has one skill slot disabled.

Withered Knight.name: Reprieve
Withered Knight.desc: Wither no longer explodes immediately when executed by a Greatsword; instead, it triggers an area explosion after a brief delay with increased damage.

Withered Knight.name: Rising Morale
Withered Knight.desc: Completing a Polearm and Shield skill cast (once its key effect triggers) increases the charge level of Charged Dash by 1 for a short duration.

Withered Knight.name: Sacred Body
Withered Knight.desc: Increases Magic Resistance.

Withered Knight.name: Seize Opportunity
Withered Knight.desc: After casting any Greatsword skill, press [Major_Action] to branch into Pursuit.

Withered Knight.name: Shield Intimidation
Withered Knight.desc: Sacred Bulwark's second strike has increased knockback distance. Enemies knocked back are stunned briefly if they collide with a wall. If they collide with another enemy, both units are stunned.

Withered Knight.name: Shield Wall Slam
Withered Knight.desc: Dodging forward while raising the shield during Charged Dash grants Super Armor, increases the dash distance, and deals damage, while also executing enemies affected by Wither.

Withered Knight.name: Succor
Withered Knight.desc: Targeting an ally in a downed state with Intervene applies a Redemption Mark. While marked, the target cannot be executed and will automatically be revived after a set duration. The mark breaks upon sustaining a certain amount of impact.

Withered Knight.name: Tactical Prep
Withered Knight.desc: A successful parry greatly reduces this skill's remaining cooldown once.

Withered Knight.name: Unstoppable
Withered Knight.desc: Branched counterattacks after a successful parry grant Super Armor.

Withered Knight.name: Whiplash
Withered Knight.desc: The final strike of Radiant Retribution can execute enemies affected by Wither.
